verdict.rationale: Antigravity ships a CLI, a Python Agent SDK, and Scheduled Tasks with cron scheduling that let agents run autonomously in the background, which together support scripted/automated workflows (antigravity-docs-2, antigravity-docs-9/13). However, there is no explicit documentation of a headless/non-interactive CLI flag or scripting example, nor independent confirmation of this specific use case. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CLI automation flags or examples, and third-party/hands-on validation of non-interactive scripting.
